Name: Joja Shopping Carts - Minecart Replacement
Author: LeelooStardew
Description:
During repairs, Joja replaced the broken minecarts with stainless steel, turbo-boosted shopping carts, straight from your local JojaMart!

[list]
[*]Only works if you’re a Joja member and purchased the minecart upgrade through the Joja Form.[/*]
[*]Comes compatible with most of the minecart system mods such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23311]PolyCarts[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11881]Integrated Minecarts[/url].[/*]
[*]Does not change the minecarts found inside the mines or Skull Cavern, or the lootable coal carts.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#3c78d8][size=4][b][i]💙[/i]THRIVE💙[/b][/size][/color]
